answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents stops being free and becomes a priced attack. Like a reef that only grows when each coral polyp earns its place, trust accrues slowly through verified work and attestations, while a single signed quill of false history forfeits the stake. Reaching the zenith of reputation then demands sustained honest service, not a flood of cheap clones.
